message.content: Let me look at the build script to understand how to compile the fuzzer:

content:
Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh:
     1	
     2	pushd $SRC/freetype2
     3	./autogen.sh
     4	./configure --prefix="$WORK" --disable-shared PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$WORK/lib/pkgconfig"
     5	make -j$(nproc)
     6	make install
     7	pushd $SRC/Little-CMS
     8	./configure --prefix="$WORK" --disable-shared PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$WORK/lib/pkgconfig"
     9	make -j$(nproc)
    10	make install
    11	mkdir -p $SRC/openjpeg/build
    12	pushd $SRC/openjpeg/build
    13	cmake .. -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$WORK
    14	make -j$(nproc) install
    15	mkdir -p $SRC/poppler/build
    16	pushd $SRC/poppler/build
    17	cmake ..   -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=debug   -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF   -DFONT_CONFIGURATION=generic   -DENABLE_DCTDECODER=none   -DENABLE_LIBPNG=OFF   -DENABLE_ZLIB=OFF   -DENABLE_LIBTIFF=OFF   -DENABLE_LIBJPEG=OFF   -DENABLE_GLIB=OFF   -DENABLE_LIBCURL=OFF   -DENABLE_QT5=OFF   -DENABLE_UTILS=OFF   -DWITH_Cairo=OFF   -DWITH_NSS3=OFF   -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$WORK
    18	make -j$(nproc) poppler poppler-cpp
    19	fuzz_target=pdf_fuzzer
    20	$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -I$SRC/poppler/cpp     $SRC/fuzz/pdf_fuzzer.cc -o $OUT/$fuzz_target     $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE     $SRC/poppler/build/cpp/libpoppler-cpp.a     $SRC/poppler/build/libpoppler.a     $WORK/lib/libfreetype.a     $WORK/lib/liblcms2.a     $WORK/lib/libopenjp2.a
    21	mv $SRC/{*.zip,*.dict} $OUT
    22	if [ ! -f "${OUT}/${fuzz_target}_seed_corpus.zip" ]; then
    23	  echo "missing seed corpus"
    24	  exit 1
    25	fi
    26	if [ ! -f "${OUT}/${fuzz_target}.dict" ]; then
    27	  echo "missing dictionary"
    28	  exit 1
